name: The Fool
meaning_upright: A winged youth leaping from a cliff into a luminous sky, fox and butterflies swirling. Boundless trust, new beginnings, wonder.
meaning_reversed: Heedless risks, naivety, missed adventure, fear of the leap.

name: The Magician
meaning_upright: A young mage channeling elemental energies, foxfire in hand. Willpower, creation, skill, focused intent.
meaning_reversed: Manipulation, wasted talent, deception, lack of direction.

name: The High Priestess
meaning_upright: A serene woman on a crescent moon, surrounded by owls and mist. Inner knowing, mystery, divine feminine, the veil.
meaning_reversed: Hidden agendas, surface living, disconnection from intuition.

name: The Empress
meaning_upright: A mother figure wreathed in blooms and songbirds, life flowing from her hands. Fertility, abundance, creativity, nurturing.
meaning_reversed: Creative block, dependence, smothering, barrenness.

name: The Emperor
meaning_upright: A crowned king on a stone throne, mountain eagles circling. Structure, authority, protection, stability.
meaning_reversed: Tyranny, rigidity, domination, overbearing control.

name: The Hierophant
meaning_upright: A sage figure beneath a great oak with acolytes. Tradition, spiritual community, sacred knowledge, guidance.
meaning_reversed: Blind conformity, restrictive dogma, unorthodox paths, rebellion.

name: The Lovers
meaning_upright: Two figures entwined in a bower of roses and fireflies. Sacred union, deep choice, heart's alignment, partnership.
meaning_reversed: Disunion, poor choices, misaligned values, temptation.

name: The Chariot
meaning_upright: A hero riding two sphinx-like creatures across a shimmering plain. Victory, willpower, control, momentum.
meaning_reversed: Defeat, aggression, scattered force, loss of direction.

name: Strength
meaning_upright: A gentle maiden with a lion, both serene. Inner courage, compassion over force, taming the wild self.
meaning_reversed: Self-doubt, weakness, raw emotion, inner conflict.

name: The Hermit
meaning_upright: A cloaked elder with a lantern walking a misty mountain path. Introspection, solitude, inner guidance, withdrawal.
meaning_reversed: Isolation, excessive withdrawal, loneliness, stagnation.

name: Wheel of Fortune
meaning_upright: A great wheel turning in the cosmos, creatures ascending and descending. Fate, cycles, turning points, destiny.
meaning_reversed: Bad luck, clinging to the past, resisting cycles.

name: Justice
meaning_upright: A blindfolded figure with balanced scales in a palace of symmetry. Truth, fairness, karmic balance, accountability.
meaning_reversed: Injustice, bias, dishonesty, imbalance.

name: The Hanged Man
meaning_upright: A youth hanging from a tree branch over water, peaceful. Surrender, new perspective, voluntary pause, illumination.
meaning_reversed: Stubbornness, wasted sacrifice, stalling, martyrdom.

name: Death
meaning_upright: A pale rider on horseback, flowers blooming in the wake. Endings, transformation, necessary change, rebirth.
meaning_reversed: Resistance to change, stagnation, fear of endings.

name: Temperance
meaning_upright: An angel pouring water between two goblets in a rainbow garden. Balance, alchemy, healing, patience, moderation.
meaning_reversed: Excess, imbalance, lack of harmony, impatience.

name: The Devil
meaning_upright: Two figures chained to a dark throne, yet chains are loose. Bondage, illusion of captivity, materialism, shadow.
meaning_reversed: Release from chains, freedom, recognition of illusion.

name: The Tower
meaning_upright: A great spire struck by lightning, figures falling into the sea. Sudden upheaval, chaos, revelation, dismantling.
meaning_reversed: Averting disaster, fear of change, postponed upheaval.

name: The Star
meaning_upright: A luminous maiden pouring starlight into a pond. Hope, renewal, inspiration, healing, calm after storm.
meaning_reversed: Despair, lost hope, disconnection, disillusionment.

name: The Moon
meaning_upright: A moonlit sea with shadow creatures, a path winding into darkness. Illusion, the unconscious, psychic depth, uncertainty.
meaning_reversed: Clarity emerging, releasing fear, dispelling illusions.

name: The Sun
meaning_upright: A golden child dancing in a sunflower field, pure light. Joy, vitality, success, clarity, radiant life.
meaning_reversed: Blocked joy, overconfidence, delays, inner child wound.

name: Judgement
meaning_upright: Angels blowing horns, figures rising from water awakened. Awakening, absolution, inner calling, transformation.
meaning_reversed: Self-doubt, ignoring the call, stagnation, self-judgment.

name: The World
meaning_upright: A dancer at the center of a laurel wreath, the four elements surrounding. Completion, wholeness, integration, fulfillment.
meaning_reversed: Incompletion, loose ends, avoiding closure, stagnation.

name: Ace of Wands
meaning_upright: A blazing torch rising from an open hand amid fireflies. A new creative spark, inspired beginning, untapped potential, pure fire of initiative.
meaning_reversed: Blocked inspiration, missed opportunities, delays in starting, lack of motivation.

name: Two of Wands
meaning_upright: A figure gazing over misty lands from a balcony, two wands flanking. Planning and vision; standing at a crossroads, mapping the journey ahead, personal power.
meaning_reversed: Poor planning, impatience, not seeing the big picture, fear of change.

name: Three of Wands
meaning_upright: A traveler watching three ships sail toward the horizon. Expansion and foresight; looking ahead with confidence, early success, exploring horizons.
meaning_reversed: Delays, lack of foresight, obstacles to growth, arrogance.

name: Four of Wands
meaning_upright: Four wands forming a floral arch, celebration beneath. Celebration and community; homecoming, harmony, foundation built, festive rest.
meaning_reversed: Lack of harmony, cancelled celebration, instability in foundations.

name: Five of Wands
meaning_upright: Five imps quarreling over scattered wands in a meadow. Conflict and competition; creative tension, rivalry, learning through challenge.
meaning_reversed: Avoiding conflict, unnecessary arguments, aggression, lack of challenge.

name: Six of Wands
meaning_upright: A victorious rider with a laurel crown, wand raised high. Victory and public recognition; success acknowledged, leadership, overcoming obstacles.
meaning_reversed: Delayed success, fall from grace, arrogance, failed recognition.

name: Seven of Wands
meaning_upright: A lone defender on a cliff, holding off six below. Courage under pressure; standing your ground, defensive strength, perseverance.
meaning_reversed: Giving up, running away, overwhelming odds, losing ground.

name: Eight of Wands
meaning_upright: Eight wands streaking through a twilight sky like falling stars. Swift action and movement; fast developments, momentum, messages traveling quickly.
meaning_reversed: Delays, frustration, canceled plans, resisting necessary speed.

name: Nine of Wands
meaning_upright: A weary warrior leaning on a wand, wounds but unyielding. Resilience and persistence; wounded but holding on, inner reserves, preparedness.
meaning_reversed: Paranoia, stubbornness, not healing from wounds, defensive excess.

name: Ten of Wands
meaning_upright: A figure struggling under a heavy load of ten wands. Burden and completion; the weight of accumulated responsibilities, near the finish.
meaning_reversed: Carrying too much, inability to delegate, near collapse, oppressive burden.

name: Page of Wands
meaning_upright: A young sprite dancing with a tall wand amid autumn leaves. Curiosity and enthusiasm; a beginner's energy, fresh perspectives, eager learning.
meaning_reversed: Creative blocks, scattered energy, immaturity, undeveloped ideas.

name: Knight of Wands
meaning_upright: A bold knight on a rearing steed amid swirling flames. Passionate action; bold advance, impulsive drive, adventurous spirit, courage.
meaning_reversed: Recklessness, impatience, haste making waste, scattered fire.

name: Queen of Wands
meaning_upright: A seated queen with sunflowers and cats, fire in her eyes. Confidence and authority; natural leadership, magnetic presence, creativity in command.
meaning_reversed: Bossy, volatile, demanding, using power poorly, creative drought.

name: King of Wands
meaning_upright: A majestic king enthroned on volcanic rock, lions at his feet. Mastery and vision; inspired authority, bold vision, the fire that guides others.
meaning_reversed: Arrogance, impulsiveness, ruthlessness, using fire to burn others.

name: Ace of Cups
meaning_upright: A crystal cup rising from a luminous pool, doves circling. New emotional beginning, overflowing love, opening the heart, spiritual gift.
meaning_reversed: Blocked emotions, closed heart, missed spiritual opportunity, emotional immaturity.

name: Two of Cups
meaning_upright: Two figures exchanging garlands over a chalice. Partnership and mutual feeling; connection, attraction, coming together in love.
meaning_reversed: Imbalance in relationship, codependency, crossed signals, bad communication.

name: Three of Cups
meaning_upright: Three maidens dancing in a moonlit glade, cups raised. Celebration and friendship; joy shared among community, abundance of feeling.
meaning_reversed: Overindulgence, cancelled celebration, isolation, jealousy among friends.

name: Four of Cups
meaning_upright: A youth beneath a tree, ignoring three cups, a fourth offered. Contemplation; stillness, introspection, boredom with what is offered, inner restlessness.
meaning_reversed: Emotional withdrawal, missing what's in front of you, boredom, depression.

name: Five of Cups
meaning_upright: A cloaked figure mourning three spilled cups, two stand behind. Loss and grief; mourning what was, regret, focusing on what is gone.
meaning_reversed: Acceptance and moving on, focusing on what remains, releasing grief.

name: Six of Cups
meaning_upright: Two children in a garden, offering cups of flowers to each other. Nostalgia and kindness; childhood memories, innocence, generosity, simple joy.
meaning_reversed: Living in the past, naivety, unresolved childhood issues, lost innocence.

name: Seven of Cups
meaning_upright: A figure lost in seven dream-clouds each holding a wonder. Fantasy and wishful thinking; many possibilities, temptation, dreams awaiting discernment.
meaning_reversed: Clarity about illusions, temptation resisted, facing reality, disillusion.

name: Eight of Cups
meaning_upright: A cloaked wanderer leaving eight cups beneath a moon. Moving on with purpose; leaving behind the comfortable to seek something greater.
meaning_reversed: Fear of moving on, staying in a comfort zone, unable to let go.

name: Nine of Cups
meaning_upright: A contented merchant resting amid nine gleaming cups. Contentment and satisfaction; wishes fulfilled, emotional abundance, quiet happiness.
meaning_reversed: Materialism, greed, smug self-satisfaction, unhappiness with abundance.

name: Ten of Cups
meaning_upright: A joyful family under a rainbow arch of ten cups. Emotional fulfillment; family bliss, community joy, long-term happiness, love.
meaning_reversed: Broken home, conflict within family, misaligned values, joyless community.

name: Page of Cups
meaning_upright: A young mermaid cradling a cup, watching a fish leap. Sensitivity and new emotional awareness; curiosity of the heart, messages from the intuitive.
meaning_reversed: Emotional immaturity, false visions, unreliable intuition, escapism.

name: Knight of Cups
meaning_upright: A dreamy knight on a white horse approaching a misty lake. Romance and intuition; following the heart, dreamy pursuit, emotional quest.
meaning_reversed: Moodiness, poor emotional decisions, jealousy, romantic disappointment.

name: Queen of Cups
meaning_upright: A water queen enthroned on a shell throne, holding a goblet. Emotional depth and nurturing; the caring heart, intuitive wisdom, compassionate leadership.
meaning_reversed: Moodiness, emotional manipulation, self-pity, smothering love.

name: King of Cups
meaning_upright: A sea king on a wave-throne, calm amid the deep. Emotional mastery and wisdom; calm authority over feeling, healing presence, deep compassion.
meaning_reversed: Emotional coldness, manipulation, unresolved wounds, abuse of empathy.

name: Ace of Swords
meaning_upright: A single brilliant sword rising from the clouds, sky clearing. Mental clarity and breakthrough; truth cutting through confusion, the sword of discernment.
meaning_reversed: Mental confusion, clouded thinking, poor decisions, misused truth.

name: Two of Swords
meaning_upright: A blindfolded figure balancing two swords over crashing waves. Difficult choice; stalemate, avoidance, temporary peace through willful blindness.
meaning_reversed: Indecision, information overload, stalemate broken badly, forced choice.

name: Three of Swords
meaning_upright: Three swords piercing a heart amid falling rain and petals. Heartbreak and sorrow; grief, betrayal, necessary pain that opens the heart.
meaning_reversed: Healing from heartbreak, releasing pain, forgiveness, mending.

name: Four of Swords
meaning_upright: A knight lying in meditation, three swords above, one below. Rest and recovery; retreat, convalescence, peaceful contemplation after conflict.
meaning_reversed: Restlessness, inability to rest, recovery avoided, stagnation.

name: Five of Swords
meaning_upright: A victor gathering swords as two defeated figures walk away. Defeat and loss; hollow victory, conflict with lasting damage, humiliation.
meaning_reversed: Recovery from conflict, cutting losses, reconciliation, moving past defeat.

name: Six of Swords
meaning_upright: A ferryman guiding a boat of mourners through still misty water. Transition and passage; moving through difficulty, guided crossing, journey.
meaning_reversed: Stuck in the past, refusal to move on, resistance to guidance.

name: Seven of Swords
meaning_upright: A rogue slipping away from a camp carrying stolen swords. Deception and cunning; strategy, theft of ideas, getting away with something.
meaning_reversed: Conscience, facing deception, caught in a lie, reconsideration.

name: Eight of Swords
meaning_upright: A bound figure surrounded by eight swords, but capable of escape. Restriction and self-limiting beliefs; feeling trapped, mind as prison, victim thinking.
meaning_reversed: Freedom from self-limiting beliefs, release from restriction, emerging.

name: Nine of Swords
meaning_upright: A figure sitting up in bed, nine swords etched in nightmare. Anxiety and nightmares; fear spiraling in the dark, worry, mental anguish.
meaning_reversed: Shame and despair released, slowly healing, worries diminishing.

name: Ten of Swords
meaning_upright: A fallen warrior, ten swords on an empty shore, dawn breaking. Ending and crisis; the nadir, rock bottom, painful conclusion, surrender to truth.
meaning_reversed: Recovery from crisis, survival, the darkest night passing, rising again.

name: Page of Swords
meaning_upright: A quick-eyed youth with a sword aloft, watching the wind. Intellectual curiosity; sharp mind, message received, new information, observant wit.
meaning_reversed: Scatteredness, gossip, impulsive talk, superficial curiosity, poor planning.

name: Knight of Swords
meaning_upright: A charging warrior on a pale horse through a storm. Swift intelligence; charging toward truth, decisive action, impatience for resolution.
meaning_reversed: Recklessness, scattered aggression, too much haste, destructive impulse.

name: Queen of Swords
meaning_upright: A severe queen enthroned in mist, one hand raised. Sharp discernment; clear judgment, honest assessment, decisive wisdom, perceptive authority.
meaning_reversed: Cruelty, cold judgment, harsh words used as weapons, cutting too deep.

name: King of Swords
meaning_upright: A stern judge-king, sword upright, in a castle of clouds. Mental mastery; keen intellect, fair judgment, cool analysis, ethical clarity.
meaning_reversed: Cruelty, abuse of intellect, tyrannical coldness, manipulative logic.

name: Ace of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A great pentacle emerging from a blossoming tree in open hands. Material opportunity, new financial beginning, manifestation of potential, gift of the earth.
meaning_reversed: Missed opportunities, poor financial decisions, lack of manifestation, squandered potential.

name: Two of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A dancer balancing two pentacles amid twisting vines. Adaptability and balance; juggling priorities, flexibility, managing resources.
meaning_reversed: Imbalance, disorganization, financial instability, inability to juggle demands.

name: Three of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Three artisans in a cathedral workshop sharing skills. Teamwork and skilled craftsmanship; collaboration, mastery through effort, recognized work.
meaning_reversed: Lack of teamwork, poor craftsmanship, unacknowledged work, creative blocks.

name: Four of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A miser seated on a strongbox, arms wrapped around coins. Financial security and conservation; holding onto resources, stability, but possible hoarding.
meaning_reversed: Materialism, greed, hoarding, financial obsession, fear of loss.

name: Five of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Two weary travelers passing a glowing stained-glass window. Material hardship; poverty, exclusion, asking for help, enduring difficulty.
meaning_reversed: Recovery from hardship, seeking support, charity accepted, isolation ending.

name: Six of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A merchant weighing pentacles, scales held high, giving to those below. Generosity and sharing; giving and receiving, fair distribution, charity.
meaning_reversed: Greed, debt, selfishness, poor financial management, imbalanced giving.

name: Seven of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A gardener resting beside a sprawling vine of pentacle-fruit. Patience and assessment; taking stock of progress, long-term investment, waiting for harvest.
meaning_reversed: Impatience, poor investment, lack of foresight, abandoned projects.

name: Eight of Pentacles
meaning_upright: An apprentice carving intricate pentacles, focused and precise. Focused skill and improvement; diligence, craftsmanship, incremental mastery.
meaning_reversed: Perfectionism, poor quality, lack of focus, amateur effort.

name: Nine of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A wealthy woman in a garden, falcon on her wrist, grapes nearby. Independence and material comfort; self-sufficiency, enjoying the fruits of labor.
meaning_reversed: Overwork, isolation, all work no play, financial security at cost of living.

name: Ten of Pentacles
meaning_upright: An elder family under an ancestral archway of pentacles. Legacy and family prosperity; ancestral wealth, long-term security, generational roots.
meaning_reversed: Financial dysfunction, family debt, broken legacy, lost inheritance.

name: Page of Pentacles

meaning_reversed: Immaturity with money, naivety, wasted learning, lazy approach.

name: Knight of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A methodical knight plowing through earth on a sturdy horse. Reliable effort; steadfast persistence, methodical approach, patient progress.
meaning_reversed: Stubbornness, laziness, dull persistence without progress.

name: Queen of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A nurturing earth queen surrounded by blooms and cornucopias. Nurturing abundance; the fertile ground of care, generosity, practical wisdom.
meaning_reversed: Overprotective, smothering with money, financial control, neglect.

name: King of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A prosperous king on an earthen throne, vineyard behind. Material mastery; prosperity through patience, stable authority, practical leadership.
meaning_reversed: Corruption, greed, financial mismanagement, abuse of material power.
